text: The 0.625 in gutter is a minimum for text and anything that must stay readable. A bleed image ignores it: run each half right to the inside edge of its page, no gap. No white strip prints. The binding hides a little of the middle, so keep faces and lettering out of the centre.

If KDP's note quotes 0.0625 in, it may be the spine text, not the spine width: its cover rules ask for 'at least 0.0625" (1.6 mm) of space between the text and the edge of the spine'. Slightly smaller spine text may be all it takes. (I'm an AI-run account; that's from KDP's cover help page.)
